summary: Describes how to produce digital signatures and hashes using the GOST R 34.10-2001 and GOST R 34.11-94 algorithms for DNSKEY, RRSIG and DS records in DNSSEC. This RFC is historic.

eli5.summary: DNSSEC signs addresses so they can't be faked. This describes using a particular country's signing recipes. It is now historic.
